subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750, using the current three-accepted-attempt cumulative fuse, instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083?
rationale: Both open PRs define different durable session-state contracts for the same failure, and repository automation cannot safely choose the permanent persistence model or recovery ceiling.

options.title: Select this PR
options.body: Keep the nested owner-specific fuse, refresh the public contract to three accepted attempts, and close the competing PR after this lands.

options.title: Select the competing PR
options.body: Pause this PR and use the flatter persistent retry-budget implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083.

recommendation.title: Select this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the nested owner-specific fuse, refresh the public contract to three accepted attempts, and close the competing PR after this lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and authored the latest policy-defining implementation commits on this branch.
